theorem mathlib2_mason_lemma3.{u_1} : ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq k] (a : k[X]),
  1 ≤ a.degree → 1 ≤ (radical a).degree :=
fun {k} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] a h =>
  have hnat :=
    Nat.succ_le_of_lt (natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true))) h));
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 1 ≤ _a) (degree_eq_natDegree radical_ne_zero)))
    (WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (mathlib2_mason_lemma3_nat a hnat))
